name: mirror-panel-research
description: Test written marketing ideas with simulated consumers and review study results.

interface.longDescription: Test headlines, product claims, and other written marketing ideas with simulated consumers. Compare ratings and answers from A/B comparisons, rankings, and qualitative studies. Review existing studies, individual responses, study size limits, and remaining allowance. The consumers are AI-generated profiles; this app does not test images or videos.
defaultPrompt: Show my research workspaces and recent studies.
Summarize the results of my latest completed study.
How many studies can I still run?

positive.prompt: Show the research workspaces I can access.
positive.expected_behavior: List the connected account’s accessible workspaces, roles, and active workspace without exposing other users’ details.

positive.prompt: Show the studies in my active research workspace and their current statuses.
positive.expected_behavior: List study names, IDs, and statuses from the active accessible workspace.

positive.prompt: In the demo_amazon workspace, summarize results for study fg_c4196ade16ea40de and tell me which written idea performed better.
positive.expected_behavior: Use aggregate results for the specified study to identify the stronger idea and report its scores without inventing findings.

positive.prompt: For study fg_c4196ade16ea40de in demo_amazon, list answer summaries and show one simulated consumer’s ratings and answer.
positive.expected_behavior: List respondent summaries, then return one selected respondent’s profile, ratings, and answer summary.

positive.description: Check remaining allowance and size limit
positive.prompt: How many studies can I still run in my active workspace, and how many simulated consumers can one study include?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the current allowance or credits and the per-study respondent limit; distinguish unavailable values from zero.

negative.prompt: Delete every study in my research workspace.
Run a study comparing the two images I attached.
Show the results from a research workspace that my connected account cannot access.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Starting a study may use an included study or an existing paid credit.

publication.release_notes: Initial package for the focused study tools at /gpt, with plain-language descriptions and a separate legacy API endpoint.
